details: Hyderabad, Telangana • 07/2024 – 04/2025
Gathering requirements from client and continuously clarifying and reviewing them via walkthrough with stakeholders.
Drive Change management requests on Gaps identified and manage project’s Scope.
Collaborating with business users, product owners and communicating with stakeholders, system experts and share the progress using agile methodology.
Preparation of requirement specification documents, Visio diagrams, Jira, confluence, use – cases scenarios for Private Equity and Transfer of Funds
Update the Dev ops with Assumptions, Scope of requirements and following Transaction reporting changes for Global Market and OTC product regulations.
Write Acceptance criteria and UI/UX design solutions to develop the mobile app feature.
Writing SQL queries to data extraction and updating the data in financial services systems.

Active member of scrum team and act as a liaison between business and technical teams and participate in system test reviews, development design reviews, usability studies, status meetings and product/ feature walkthroughs.
Train the team members and Write Requirement specifications for Developers and testers involved in reporting chain. Assist testers in writing test cases and validate the results.

projects.name: accounting, Trade Settlement. Private Equity
details: Engage with client to gather software requirements /business rules and ensure alignment with development teams.
Using the Calypso platform for trading, Risk management and Processing.
Completed in-depth analysis of business processes.
Responsible for improve efficiencies and quality control to the Cash reconciliations process and supervising the team of 15 members.
Responsible for maintaining and reviewing the reconciliations of funds – FX, Trade and Income using TLM and handling other products like private equity.
Refines and develop the process standard operating procedures to ensure accuracy upon process updates.
Running macros to settle the custody side Trades, FX and Income.
Calling Custody monitor Macro.
Reconciling the Custody balances with accounting balances using TLM Premium and Cash Summary Macro.
Daily interaction with Onshore clients & Training team of 15 for running process operations
Reporting aged breaks, high value breaks, disputed critical funds to the Management.
NIIT Technologies PVT Ltd – Client- SEI Pvt ltd – Business Analyst – Special Activities group –  Trade Settlement, Private Equity
